patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Square Online and WooCommerce share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Square Online only if your buying job matches “Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, ” rather than WooCommerce's shape. Choose WooCommerce only if your buying job matches “Open-source WordPress commerce plugin — free core; paid extensions, hosting, and WooPaymen” rather than Square Online's shape. Workflow advantage: Square Online leans omnichannel-retail; WooCommerce leans catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Square Online and WooCommerce share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Square Online is Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, Premium $149/location; 30-day trials on paid tiers; WooCommerce is Open-source WordPress commerce plugin — free core; paid extensions, hosting, and WooPayments processing are separate TCO lines..
- Workflow coverage skew: Square Online-leaning omnichannel-retail vs WooCommerce-leaning catalog-management.
- Researched limits: Square Online — Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify; WooCommerce — You own hosting, security, updates, and plugin compatibility — operational burden vs SaaS.

Limitations — Square Online: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify; Free tier online processing spread (3.3% + 30¢) can exceed paid-tier savings at volume; WooCommerce: You own hosting, security, updates, and plugin compatibility — operational burden vs SaaS; Extension sprawl can inflate TCO and maintenance.

Poor-fit cases: Square Online is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify · WooCommerce is a poor fit when that limitation bites: You own hosting, security, updates, and plugin compatibility — operational burden vs SaaS · Avoid Square Online if you actually need WooCommerce's motion (Open-source WordPress commerce plugin — free core; paid extensions, hosting, and)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
